commentary_segments.text: In this Chapter, an introduction is given on distortion caused by the weak nonlinearities of the transistors. The definitions of distortion have been given first. They are followed by distortion calculations of MOST and bipolar devices in both single and differential configurations. Considerable attention is paid to the reduction of distortion by feedback. Finally some guide lines and overview Tables are added to allow easy prediction of distortion levels in any kind of amplifier.
